 13 goals in 13 apps: Man United plot mid-season swoop for talismanic frontman just four months after £20m move
 By Isabel Ryan 
 Posted on November 16, 2026 
 (Photo by Harriet Massey/Getty Images)
 Share 
 Tweet 
 Share 
 Share 
 Email 
 Comments 
 Manchester United have reportedly added their names to the list of top-flight clubs sizing up a swoop for Will Lankshear. 
 It comes just four months after the prolific forward joined Middlesbrough from Tottenham Hotspur in a £20 million deal. 
 How Will Lankshear is faring in 2026/2027  
 (Photo by Jan Kruger/Getty Images) Since then, Lankshear has established himself as one of the most exciting prospects in England. 
 He has netted a stunning 13 goals in 13 Championship matches, including seven goals in his last five appearances. 
 Will Lankshear that is outrageous 😍 @Boro #EFL | #SkyBetChampionship pic.twitter.com/pU5h1ue1Hn 
 — Sky Bet Championship (@SkyBetChamp) October 31, 2026 
 Such scintillating form reportedly had the 21-year-old in contention for his first-ever senior England call-up during the current international break, but Thomas Tuchel eventually opted for the likes of Dominic Calvert-Lewin and Liverpool youngster Rio Ngumoha. 
 Lankshear had pulled up with a hamstring injury during Boro’s 3-0 win over Charlton Athletic, in which he notched a brace, causing him to miss the subsequent fixtures against Wrexham and Watford before club action hit pause. 
 Who are Lankshear’s suitors?  
 (Photo by Harriet Massey/Getty Images) According to TeamTalk , Arsenal, Brighton and Hove Albion, Everton, Newcastle United, Sunderland and Leeds United have all joined the Red Devils in monitoring Lankshear in the lead-up to the January window. 
 However, it goes without saying that Middlesbrough will be entirely closed off to the possibility of facilitating their talisman’s departure mid-season, especially while they’re pushing for promotion; they currently sit second in the division, but are joint on points (29) with leaders Birmingham City and Stoke City in third. 
 Spurs are also said to have matching rights for their academy graduate in any potential future deal and, amid the exile of Richarlison and injury setback to Mathys Tel, they could well start considering utilising their option sooner rather than later. 
 🚨| #Tottenham scouts are understood to have watched Will Lankshear this season. However, Middlesbrough are determined to ward off any January interest, placing a staggering £70million valuation on the striker. @TomBarclay_ pic.twitter.com/j8XN3DOz0r 
 — The Spurs Express (@TheSpursExpress) November 15, 2026 
 United’s interest in a centre-forward has increased in the aftermath of Benjamin Sesko’s layoff , with the Slovenian out of action since mid-September, and the fact that Joshua Zirkzee has struggled to make a lasting impression when trusted from the off.
